text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’m passionate, hard-working, and focused on helping businesses make better financial decisions.

With 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, SQL, Power BI, Google Sheets, dashboard building, data cleaning, and data visualization, I can help monitor your company’s financial trends, organize historical financials, and prepare clear, actionable reports. I’m comfortable working with financial data to identify anomalies, highlight potential concerns, and support budget preparation with a clean, structured approach.

I’d be glad to help you gain better visibility into your financial status and provide reporting that supports confident decision-making. I take pride in delivering accurate, easy-to-understand analysis and dependable communication.

I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can support your title company as a fractional/virtual CFO.
